figures.finding: No film fund or production incentive exists in South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands; there is no resident industry and no visitor accommodation ashore, and all visitors arrive by sea.

value.access: by sea only; no visitor accommodation ashore

figures.applies: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands, 2026.

sources.said: South Georgia & the South Sandwich Islands are only accessible by sea. There is no visitor accommodation ashore … All visitors are subject to the Entry Control Ordinance 2022.
There are no permanent residents in the Territory but the British Antarctic Survey (BAS) operates two bases on South Georgia.
There is no permanent human population on South Georgia.
